title: Sewn Hexes
description: Provides various patches for Hexwoven (along with a couple items)
body:
# Sewn Hexes
This mod provides random patches for [Hexwoven](https://modrinth.com/modpack/hexwoven) along with a couple items

## Patches & Fixes
- Fixed Autograph occasionally signing air (0.1.1+)

## Items
(All pigments are crafted with the item listed and amethyst dust on all 4 sides)
- Noctshade Pigment
  - Crafted with Demiboy Pigment
- Duskblood Pigment
  - Crafted with Glowstone

More will be added later
